description: This source file defines the ValidateProjectNameAPI class, which is an API endpoint for validating the uniqueness of a project name within a human resource management system. It handles HTTP GET requests, validates input parameters, interacts with the project service to check name availability, and returns a response indicating whether the project name can be used.

classes.name: ValidateProjectNameAPI
